description: Per-weapon-class VR-ready fallback candidates. NOT adopted: no candidate has passed a labelled fixed-camera comparison, and no engine model substitution is implemented yet. This manifest exists so the next stage has a concrete, reviewable target.

policy.why: The shipped SD viewmodels were authored for flat-screen play. No engine-side rotation, attachment-pair or hitbox proxy can make them VR-correct: the baked hand detaches and the visible barrel stays 20-80 degrees off the aim ray.
policy.rule: For Bronze/Silver mods, do not try to repair the mod's own viewmodel. Render a VR-ready fallback model for the weapon CLASS while the mod keeps its own damage, fire rate, animations, sounds and ballistics.
policy.exit_criterion: One labelled fixed-camera comparison sheet per class with maintainer ADVANCE, then a fresh V3 PASS at that commit. Until then every entry is validated=false.
policy.credits: Before adoption, add source URL and author credit to assets/valve_vr/CREDITS.md for every third-party MDL.
